text: I would like the Committee to hear from City of Toronto staff about accessibility considerations for the underground PATH system. Specifically, whether after-hours accessibility can be improved, and whether the possibility of creating an accessibility map has been considered.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. The General Government and Licensing Committee request the Deputy City Manager, Infrastructure and Development Services to arrange for a staff presentation to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee in the first quarter of 2020 regarding accessibility in the underground PATH system, including: a. after-hours PATH access; and b. an accessibility map.
